description: A random voltage source built on smooth noise, running anywhere from one cycle in a thousand seconds to audio rate

params.text: Sets how fast the noise moves, from 0.001Hz at the bottom to 440Hz at the top, spread evenly in octaves
Picks which of 128 fixed random patterns this module follows, so the same seed can give a different shape here

inputs.text: Scales the pace slider down, -5V stopping the noise altogether and +5V leaving the slider where it is
A rising edge past 1V samples the noise and holds it until the next edge; with nothing patched the output moves continuously instead
A rising edge past 1V sends the noise back to the start of its pattern

notes: this module runs on its own; an Omen to its left only replaces the seed the noise is built from
the lamp on the slider is green while the output is positive and red while it is negative, brighter the further from 0V

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the slider's own position; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads nothing held, the noise runs on; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
